title: Grok Build and OpenCode CLIs are installed on this development machine
body: Run Grok Build and OpenCode checks directly: both CLIs are installed on this machine (`grok --version` 1.0.41 and `opencode --version` 1.16.2 on 2026-10-21; grok was 1.0.25 on 2026-09-19). Useful: `grok inspect` (lists the instructions, skills, hooks and MCP servers discovered for the current project), `grok plugin validate <path>` (validates a plugin manifest and lists its components; it passes manifests Grok then ignores, so confirm with inspect) and `opencode debug startup` (loads the configured plugins, including a local file:// path, and says whether startup completed without an import-time crash). Prefer them to assuming a harness integration can only be checked by hand. Why: the 2026-09-19 install plan had treated both as manual, probably unavailable steps; both were present and gave real signal.
not_derivable: What is installed on the development machine is recorded nowhere in the repository.

evidence.summary: 2026-09-19: grok 1.0.25 and opencode 1.16.2 installed and working against this repository, including a local file:// plugin path.
